5 تقمّص فِى النَّهْرِ He turned over, and became immersed, in the river. (TA.) ＝
-A2- تقمّص, (K,) or تقمّص قَمِيصًا, (S, M, A, Msb,) He clad himself with a قميص [or shirt]. (S, M, A, Msb, K.) [Hence] you say, تقمّص الإِمَارَةَ and الوِلَايَةَ (tropical:) [He became invested with the office of commander, prefect, or the like]. (TA.) And تقمّص لِبَاسَ العِزِّ (tropical:) [He became invested with might, or nobility. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
